pamphlet_excerpts: Not Pet Owner: If you are not a pet owner and plan to buy or adopt ananimal to earn this merit badge, first give serious thoughtto pet ownership.
Realize Responsiblepet Owner: You must realize what every responsiblepet owner already knows: It takes time, effort, and moneyto care for a pet properly.
Ensure Quality Health: You must ensure quality health care for yourpet, which could include vaccinations and preventive andemergency care as needed.
Time Properlytrain Pet: You must take the time to properlytrain your pet so that it does not become a nuisance.
step_by_step_procedure: Mustdedicate Yourself: You mustdedicate yourself to the well-being of a living animal, whichmeans sometimes giving up other activities, such as TV, totend to your pet’s.
Understand Thatdifferent: Understand thatdifferent pets require different living arrangements.
Municipal Laws Restrict: Municipal laws may restrict the types of pets you.
Baby Canaries Egg: Give baby canaries all the egg food (available at pet stores) and conditioning food they want.

pamphlet_excerpts: Mixingmales Andfemales: Mixingmales andfemales, besidescreating lots ofbaby hamsters, might lead tohamster fights.
Diarrhea Wet Tail: Diarrhea, sometimes called “wet tail,” is aserious conditionthat requiresveterinary attention.
Feed Commercial Hamster: Feed a commercial hamster diet that contains at least 16 percent protein.
Not Feed Seed-type: Do not feed seed-type pet mixesbecause the hamster will pick out only the foods itwants and hoard (bury) the rest.
step_by_step_procedure: Hamsters Tend Tostuff: Hamsters tend tostuff their cheeks with food and then storeit away.
Hoarded Food Spoil: Hoarded food will only spoil androt, and you must remove it from the cageregularly.
Occurs Discontinue Foodsfor: If this occurs, discontinue these foodsfor a few days.
Hamster Front Teeth: A hamster’s front teeth grow continuously and normallyare worn down by chewing on hard items.

pamphlet_excerpts: Findout Kindof Food: Before you buy atype of fish, findout what kindof food it needs.

Filter But Mustbe: A filter will help, but it mustbe cleaned every week.
step_by_step_procedure: Siphon Remove Food: Use a siphon to remove the food anddroppings that accumulate in the bottom of the tank.
Waterthat Little Green: Waterthat is a little green will not harm your fish, but when it getssoupy and opaque, you had better change it.
Additionally Youalso Replace: Additionally, youalso must replace water that evaporates over time.
Age Newwater Overnight: Age the newwater overnight before adding it to the tank, or use a chemicaldechlorinator (under the close supervision of an adult).

Obedience Training Begin: Obedience training can begin when dogs are 4 to 6 months old and continue throughout a dog’s lifetime.
Obedience-trained Dogs Pets: Obedience-trained dogs make better pets, have fewer behavioral problems, and generally bond more closely withtheir owners.
There Training Methods: There are many training methods, some more effectivethan others.
step_by_step_procedure: Trainer Figure Out: A good trainer can help you figure out whatworks best with your dog.
Excellent Way Totrain: This can be an excellent way totrain your pet and to improve your own skills.
Enroll Dog Once: If you decide todo this, enroll your dog once it has been vaccinated.
Ask Yourveterinarian Picking: Ask yourveterinarian for help in picking a class that matches yourdog’s abilities.

requirements.req_text: Do ONE of the following: (a) Explore careers related to this merit badge. Research one career to learn about the training and education needed, costs, job prospects, salary, job duties, and career advancement. Your research methods may include—with your parent or guardian's permission—an internet or library search, an interview with a professional in the field, or a visit to a location where people in this career work. Discuss with your counselor both your findings and what about this profession might make it an interesting career. (b) Explore how you could use knowledge and skills from this merit badge to pursue a hobby or healthy lifestyle. Research any training needed, expenses, and organizations that promote or support it. Discuss with your counselor what short-term and long-term goals you might have if you pursued this. Resource: Animal Hobbies (video)
